title: Mask PII in provenance spans and coverage for auditor and integration roles (SEC2-017)
story: As a carrier privacy officer I want auditor and integration roles to never see claimant or cited-party names, including inside provenance spans, so that redaction is consistent across endpoints
acceptance: For auditor and integration, GET /documents/{id}/extraction returns no pii:true values and provenance.span is masked or dropped whenever it contains any pii field value (the 'Cited: Mallory Fictionton' case from section 11 is the test fixture)
GET /claims/{id}/coverage applies the same PII_ROLES rule as claims/routes.mjs for auditor and integration
The SEC2-017 todo test in tests/security/sec2-rbac-pii.test.mjs passes when run locally; do not edit tests/security; tests/e2e and tests/security show no new failures
brief: Squad ticket across ai (evidence) and integrations (coverage) per playbook v2. Reuse the PII_ROLES rule from src/modules/claims/routes.mjs:3 (read it, do not edit claims).

verdicts.reason: All 4 criteria met; new tests pass, e2e+security 372 pass/0 fail matches baseline
